//: Realtime Database rules for Critter Clash.
Paste these into Firebase Console -> Realtime Database -> Rules -> Publish.
* A brand-new database is created in TEST MODE, which lets ANY person on
the internet read and delete every player's data. Test mode also expires
after 30 days and then breaks the arena entirely. Do not ship on it.
* The .indexOn entries remove the 'Using an unspecified index' warnings and
stop the client downloading whole tables just to filter them.
Model: a player may write only their own record, but any signed-in player may
read profiles (needed for matchmaking) and may append to another player's
attack log and duel inbox (needed for async attacks and live duels).

$uid.//friends: friending is mutual, so a friend writes into your record too
$uid.//trophies: an attacker settles the defender's trophy loss

$uid.//: the inbox owner reads the whole list; a challenger may follow only the one duel they opened, which is how they learn it was accepted
